answers.core: Having a direct shader documentation in the editor with the above mentioned look-up feature needs core/engine integration
answers.workaround: To an extend it would be possible to have a new entry next to the AssetLib for this or next to the shader editor but then again, you would be switching a lot. The looking-up functionality by clicking on the keyword can’t be implemented by an addon.

title: Add built-in shader documentation to the editor
